evals.expected_output: Blocking verdict — should find leaked Stripe API key, debug print statements, unrelated README changes, and missing tests for the payments module

assertions.name: verdict-is-blocking
assertions.description: The overall verdict is labelled Blocking (a Blocking cell or legend elsewhere is not a verdict).

assertions.name: detects-api-key
assertions.description: Names the leaked Stripe key; generic words like 'credential' also appear in a clean report's checklist.

assertions.name: detects-missing-tests
assertions.description: Ties the missing tests to the payments code; the word 'test' appears in every report.

assertions.name: detects-unrelated-changes
assertions.pattern: README[^\n]{0,120}(?:\b(?:unrelated|unintended|out of scope)\b|n't belong|not belong)|\b(?:unrelated|unintended|out of scope)\b[^\n]{0,120}README
assertions.description: Flags the README change as unrelated; mentioning the README is not enough.

evals.prompt: review my changes before I push
evals.expected_output: Clean verdict — focused diff with validators, corresponding tests, good commit message

assertions.name: no-false-positives
assertions.description: Was not_contains_any, which skill-eval-harness 0.6.0 does not grade (it reports it deferred and failed).

evals.prompt: can you check what I'm about to push? want to make sure nothing weird is in there
evals.expected_output: Non-Clean verdict — should find TODO/FIXME comments, skipped test, fixup commit. Written expecting Minor; SKILL.md now calibrates skipped/disabled tests as Blocking, so Minor or Blocking passes.

assertions.name: verdict-is-not-clean
assertions.description: The branch has a skipped test and an untested function: the case was written expecting Minor, but SKILL.md's calibration now lists skipped/disabled tests as Blocking, so either non-Clean verdict is accepted.

assertions.name: detects-todo-comments
assertions.description: Quotes or counts the TODO/FIXME comments; a clean report also says 'no TODO/FIXME markers'.

assertions.name: detects-fixup-commit
assertions.description: The fixup commit itself; 'no fixup or squash-candidate commits' is a clean report's checklist line.
